subject: Biology
title: What Is a Neuron?
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Is a Neuron?.

hook.text: Right now, billions of cells in your brain are firing electrical signals to let you read this.

buildup.text: A neuron has a cell body, branching dendrites that receive signals, and an axon that sends them.

discovery.text: Santiago Ramón y Cajal proved neurons are separate cells, not a fused web, winning a Nobel Prize.

twist.text: Your brain has about 86 billion neurons. Each one connects to thousands of others.

climax.text: Neurons are the basic units of thought, sensation, and movement—your body's wiring.

quiz.question: What part of a neuron sends signals to other cells?

details.summary: A neuron is a specialized cell that transmits information through electrical and chemical signals. It consists of dendrites that receive input, a cell body that integrates signals, and an axon that sends output to other neurons, muscles, or glands.
details.whyItMatters: Neurons are the fundamental units of the nervous system. The human brain contains roughly 86 billion neurons, and their connections form the physical basis of every thought, memory, emotion, and action we experience.
takeaways: Dendrites receive signals; the axon transmits them to the next cell
The cell body integrates incoming signals and decides whether to fire
The human brain contains approximately 86 billion neurons

faq.question: How fast do neurons transmit signals?
faq.answer: Speed varies from 1 to 120 meters per second depending on axon diameter and myelination. Myelinated motor neurons transmit fastest for rapid muscle control. Unmyelinated pain fibers are slower, which is why you feel a touch before the pain from stubbing your toe.

faq.question: Do we really only use 10 percent of our brain?
faq.answer: This is a myth. Brain imaging shows that virtually all brain regions are active at various times. Even during sleep, significant neural activity occurs. Evolution would not maintain an organ consuming 20 percent of the body's energy if 90 percent were unused.
